about_the_game:
What is REGRET?

Imagine a world where dictatorship and tyranny have won. You, as one of the regime’s traitors, are sent to prison to take part in the "Reintegration" program.

It’s a brutal program that selects the strongest, the smartest, and the most ruthless to return to society. Be careful and decisive, and maybe you’ll be the one to earn that tempting freedom.

Regret is a psychological cooperative elimination game for 4 players. To survive means making tough choices, betraying, bluffing, pressuring, and risking it all. Only one will reach freedom.

Gameplay Description

Sit down at a high-tech table together with the other participants. Various devices will appear on the table — each with its own unique rules, announced by a professional narrator. You will take turns making decisions:

  • which card to choose?

  • who to deceive?

  • who to pressure?

After each trial, one player is eliminated. Only one survives.

Why You’ll Love REGRET

  • 🔪 Unexpected survival games — each round is a new trial

  • ♟ Tactical decisions — one move can change everything

  • 🎧 Professional narrator voice-over — heightens the tension

  • 🌌 Deep atmosphere of fear and doubt

  • 🔁 High replayability — new situations, roles, and combinations every time

Make tough decisions: who to trust, who to betray, when to take risks and when to retreat. Your actions will affect not only your outcome but also the fate of others.

In a world where life is measured in points and the chance of salvation is decided by a spin of the wheel, the biggest question remains: what are you willing to do to survive?

short_description: Regret is an atmospheric 4-player cooperative game where you take on the role of a prisoner in a world dominated by a totalitarian dictatorship. Experience firsthand what it's like to be a victim of despotic power and fight against other players for the chance to gain your freedom.
